newsitem.title: FRANCE: TF1 1996 TV ad share slips, M6's rises-CSA.
newsitem.headline: TF1 1996 TV ad share slips, M6's rises-CSA.

text.p: The share of France's television advertising market held by the biggest French private television station, TF1, dipped to 51.64 percent in 1996 from 52.43 percent in 1995, French broadcasting watchdog CSA said on Wednesday.

The Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel said in a statement on its annual review of France's private terrestrial television stations that M6-Metropole Television's share of television advertising had risen a touch, to 16.66 percent in 1996 from 16.12 percent in 1995.
Pay television channel Canal Plus, which only carries advertising during non-encrypted broadcasts, took a 2.43 percent share in 1996, slightly down from 2.63 percent in 1995, the CSA said.
